focused_reading.title: Noise-Robust Tiny Object Localization with Flows
focused_reading.reviewed: Abstract, introduction, noise injection protocol, contributions, related work. Page3 rendered with Poppler and visually inspected.
focused_reading.prior_mechanism: Flexible normalizing-flow error distributions and uncertainty-aware gradient modulation for tiny-object annotation noise.
focused_reading.specific_evidence: The paper reports manually auditing 532 AI-TOD boxes, and training-time center Gaussian perturbations. Its annotation-noise rates are not measurements on our VisDrone data.
focused_reading.consequence: Tiny-object annotation sensitivity, noise robustness, and uncertainty weighting are established prior concepts. A candidate based on action-order stability must show a separate failure signal and matched benefit; perturbation sensitivity alone is not novelty.

focused_reading.title: Mitigating Context Bias in Domain Adaptation for Object Detection using Mask Pooling
focused_reading.reviewed: Abstract, causal motivation and foreground/background pooling description in extracted text.
focused_reading.prior_mechanism: Foreground masks separate foreground/background pooling; random-background benchmark probes domain context bias.
focused_reading.consequence: Generic masking, context suppression, and causal language do not establish originality for candidate17, which also failed its efficacy gate.

focused_reading.title: FUSEye: Training-Light Fisheye Detection with Overlapping Views and Zero-Initialized Adapters
focused_reading.reviewed: Abstract and method-description excerpts; fisheye domain differs from VisDrone.
focused_reading.prior_mechanism: Overlapping views, lightweight adaptation and learned fusion/rescoring.
focused_reading.consequence: Multi-view fusion and a small learned head alone are insufficient as an innovation claim.

focused_reading.title: TOOD: Task-aligned One-stage Object Detection
focused_reading.consequence: Task alignment is a prior baseline concept, not a new contribution of a coverage or localization variant.
